title: Monetary penalties.
bodyText: After notice and opportunity for a hearing, the insurance commissioner may impose a monetary penalty on any person or group found to be in violation of any provision of this chapter or any rule adopted thereunder. The monetary penalty shall not exceed $1,000 for each act or violation and shall not exceed $10,000 in the aggregate. The amount of any monetary penalty shall be paid to the insurance commissioner and transmitted to the director of finance for deposit into the general fund.
bodyHtml: §386-209  Monetary penalties.  After notice and opportunity for a hearing, the insurance commissioner may impose a monetary penalty on any person or group found to be in violation of any provision of this chapter or any rule adopted thereunder.  The monetary penalty shall not exceed $1,000 for each act or violation and shall not exceed $10,000 in the aggregate.  The amount of any monetary penalty shall be paid to the insurance commissioner and transmitted to the director of finance for deposit into the general fund. [L 1986, c 304, pt of §1]
